description: Run loudness analysis on TWO sources and return both results for an A/B comparison: master vs reference, before vs after a fix, two encoders, two cuts. The answer carries measureStatus: per field its status (validated, proxy, beta, withdrawn), basis and margin where known. Report a proxy as an approximation, never present a withdrawn field as what its name says, and stay inside a stated margin (https://audiolab.tools/docs/start/read-a-response#the-five-statuses). Audio source: a public https URL, or a local file path (`path`).

measureStatus.description: Add measureStatus to the answer: the status of each field. On by default; set false to leave it out.

pathA.description: First source as a local file path.

pathB.description: Second source as a local file path.

round.description: Round numbers to what they are worth (dB and LUFS 2 decimals, seconds 3, ms 1, Hz 1, shares 3); same keys and types. On by default; set false for full precision.

spectrumCalc.description: Spectrum calculation: v1 (the default until 15 February 2027) or v2 (fixes three errors found against an independent calculation; values change a little, keys do not).

urlA.description: First source URL (e.g. master). Provide urlA or pathA.

urlB.description: Second source URL (e.g. reference). Provide urlB or pathB.

name: compare_loudness
title: Compare two tracks (A/B)
